source_ids.notes: Article 1 bank XAF 10bn; Article 2 financial establishment XAF 2bn; historic 2009–2014 transition.

source_ids.host: Republic of Congo Ministry of Finance
source_ids.notes: Articles 4–7 overlap for existing institutions; legal interpretation unresolved.

unresolved_legal_questions: Does Article 7 continued force of R-2009/01 for preexisting institutions in 2026 coexist with, qualify or otherwise interact with Article 6 staged threshold and general transition? Require written interpretation.
Does a submitted but not approved capital-raising plan confer any interim regulatory relief? No automatic relief assumed.
What if a bank submitted a plan after 2026-06-30, or approval arrived after 2026-12-31? Require regulator-specific decision.
What are effects of changes to institution category, merger, licence, head office or regulatory direction?
Which publication record and subsequent amendments govern each effective-dated decision?

decision_rows.scenario: New bank licensed on or after 2026-01-01
decision_rows.action: Require evidence of fully paid-up 25bn at creation, but policy remains non-executable pending publication and amendments

decision_rows.scenario: New financial establishment licensed on or after 2026-01-01
decision_rows.action: Require evidence of fully paid-up 4bn at creation, subject to same authority gate

decision_rows.scenario: Existing institution as of 2026-06-30 with no capital plan
decision_rows.action: Do not infer unconditional compliance from old minimum; legal applicability decision required

decision_rows.scenario: Existing institution with plan merely submitted before 2026-06-30
decision_rows.action: Submission does not equal regulatory approval; staged compliance not automatically conferred

decision_rows.scenario: Existing institution with verified regulator-approved plan
decision_rows.action: Evaluate only after signed applicability, approval scope and effective date verified; milestones are proposals until policy activation

decision_rows.scenario: Existing institution at 2026-12-31 with 10bn bank capital but below 14bn
decision_rows.action: Do not auto-pass on continued old regulation or auto-fail without legal decision on plan status and Article interaction
Do not silently carry forward repealed old threshold; require approved applicable transition and publication chain
Never count unsettled claims as paid-up; no synthetic journal
Reject cross-tenant approval; preserve audit and maker-checker

state_machine: SOURCE_FOUND -> TEXT_READ -> PUBLICATION_PROVEN -> AMENDMENTS_RECONCILED -> LEGAL_INTERPRETATION_APPROVED -> INSTITUTION_PROFILE_APPROVED -> FINANCE_MAPPING_APPROVED -> POLICY_APPROVED -> ACTIVE; conflict or unknown -> HOLD
ledger_effect: NONE; regulatory evaluation cannot create, alter, or reverse a posted journal
authorization: No UI-only approval; dual legal and finance review, SoD, tamper-resistant audit, regulator decision evidence
